gbm_population_evidence.quote: GROUPS 1-3: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (GBM), IDH wild-type (by immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] R132H negative \[neg\] or sequencing). Astrocytoma with molecular features of GBM are eligible.

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I/Ib trial tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of mycophenolate mofetil in combination with temozolomide and/or radiation therapy (standard of care) in treating patients with glioblastoma.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: III. Phase 0 (Group S; Sub-Group S1 and Sub-Group S2): To evaluate drug uptake and target effect in the brain.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Id. Measure IMPDH activity assay in patients' peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) as well as in GBM tissue.

XMP concentration: Will utilize an established clinical protocol and a highly sensitive liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry method in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) isolated from glioblastoma patients receiving MMF in combination with TMZ in order to determine IMPDH activity.

role_evidence.quote: Mycophenolate Mofetil in Combination With Standard of Care for the Treatment of Glioblastoma
However, mycophenolate mofetil may also help chemotherapy with temozolomide work better by making tumor cells more sensitive to the drug.

coder_notes: Active moiety given as mycophenolic acid (MMF is its ester; record names mycophenolic acid as MMF's primary active metabolite); script mapping may prefer 'mycophenolate mofetil'. formulation_flag 'prodrug' reflects the ester form; could be 'none'. Group S (Phase 0 window, pre-surgical) plans drug uptake in brain = tumour PK yes. Temozolomide is backbone in all groups, including recurrent Group R (re-challenge). IDH-wildtype requirement stated for Groups 1-3 only; Group S/R just say glioblastoma. Phase 1 trial with non-randomized sequential groups; no control arm.
